subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable storage policy should OpenClaw use for `systemPromptReport` in retained session entries?
rationale: The remaining code change is not just a guard: maintainers need to choose whether prompt reports stay inline, move out of line, are truncated, or are retained only for active sessions because that affects diagnostics and warning-dedupe behavior.

options.title: Out-of-Line or Compact Retention
options.body: Store only the small dedupe/diagnostic subset inline and move, truncate, or drop the large repeated report payload for stale rows.

options.title: Keep Full Inline Reports
options.body: Preserve current diagnostics exactly and accept continued `sessions.json` bloat until a broader session-store redesign lands.

options.title: Drop Reports After Each Run
options.body: Remove prompt reports aggressively from persisted rows, reducing bloat but risking lost warning-dedupe and diagnostic context.

recommendation.title: Out-of-Line or Compact Retention
recommendation.body: Store only the small dedupe/diagnostic subset inline and move, truncate, or drop the large repeated report payload for stale rows.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest current routing signal for both the original prompt-report feature and the later prompt-blob storage mitigation.
